items.title: CoreWeave & Super Micro earnings are quieting AI concerns. What does this mean for Nvidia?
items.summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) and Super Micro Computer (SMCI) stocks are both surging after the companies reported quarterly earnings. Westwood's chief investment officer of alternative and multi-asset investments Adrian Helfert and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma discuss what the results suggest about overall AI demand. Helfert is also Westwood's portfolio manager of the Enhanced Income Opportunity ETF.

items.title: Korea’s Stock Market Surges Another 3.5% Overnight. Intel, Coherent, and Micron Among Most Active Premarket Stocks in US Trading.
items.summary: South Korean memory stocks just posted their biggest surge in months while U.S. premarket tells a far more complicated story, with Coherent falling despite a beat and Micron moving in the opposite direction from its Asian peers.

items.title: Cisco Networking Sales Surge on AI Demand. Why the Stock Is Down.
items.summary: Cisco Systems  is the latest tech hardware company to report strong financial results driven by ongoing artificial-intelligence demand.  On Wednesday,    Cisco  reported adjusted earnings of $1.22 a share on revenue of $17.3 billion for the fiscal fourth quarter ended on July 25.  Cisco’s networking segment—which includes gear used in AI data centers—has grown as enterprise demand for AI infrastructure continues to rise.
